# Marky v1.2.3

### Interface Polish

- **Quiet Cross-Platform Scrollbars**: Sidebar, dashboard, settings, modal, and list scrollbars now use a thin, low-contrast treatment across macOS, Windows, and Linux. The macOS WKWebView no longer falls back to a wide white classic scrollbar track when system scrollbars are always visible.
- **Intentional Visibility**: Scrollbar thumbs stay transparent at rest, appear subtly when their scroll area is active, and gain a clearer hover state without adding a visible track.

### Release Versioning

- Updated the app, Tauri, Cargo, and README versions to `1.2.3`.
